01 The Opportunity

Own your presence at a prestigious Ancaster address.

1025 Wilson Street West brings premium commercial ownership to one of Hamilton's most affluent and fastest-growing communities.

Forty-four flexible suites, eight with private ground-floor entrances, under C7 zoning, with a rooftop amenity and direct Highway 403 access. Own to occupy, or hold and lease.

08 The Builder

Delivered by Elite Developments.

Elite Developments is an established Ontario builder with a growing portfolio of residential and commercial projects across the province, united by a single purpose: Building Excellence.

The company's approach is defined by design consciousness, long-term thinking, and a commitment to enhancing the lived experience through meaningful places and thriving communities. Every Elite project is conceived as a piece of the broader civic fabric, built to perform, built to last, and built to elevate its surroundings.

1025 Wilson continues that tradition. Every architectural, planning, and material decision has been made with purchasers, end-users, and long-term value in mind.
